Use this work order format for work order update: { "owner": { "href": "http://172.30.1.110:80/vis/wapi/v1/users/94000000000005" }, "name": "WO#3-Urgent!", "due_date": "2019-02-01", "comments": "Urgent!", "is_archived": false, "is_owner_notified": false, "is_owner_notified_about_overdue": false, "href": "http://172.30.1.110:80/vis/wapi/v1/work_orders/3" }

404.description: The work order cannot be found.

post.description:
<para>New work order name must be unique throughout work orders.</para>
             Use this work order format for new work orders creation:
            
             {
               "owner": {
                "href": "http://172.30.1.110:80/vis/wapi/v1/users/94000000000005"
               },
               "name": "WO#1",
               "due_date": "2019-04-18",
               "comments": "New work order"
             }

409.description: Conflict - a new work order should not contain 'href'.

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description:
Data expansion. Usage:
'child_resource_name,...' expands child resources with names set.
'all_children' expands all child resources.

parameters.name: show_child_collections
parameters.description:
If unset or set to false all unexpanded child
            collections contain just a single "href" link. Otherwise they also contain basic collection
            info.

delete.description: Work orders in use cannot be deleted.
